house.why: The colony is built from hull plates, machined panels, domes and boards. Machined spacecraft structure is its high craft, so every creed is cut from that one engineered kit.

ideologies.name: Charter Unionism

fit.variant: Steady interlaced rings, each one bound to its neighbours like clauses of a charter, in Charter blue on a deep navy ground.
fit.emblem: The Concord globe of the Charter.

ideologies.why: Linked rings read as law and mutual guarantee, and they echo the orbit line. Charter blue suits its dutiful, homesick mood.

ideologies.name: Concessionary Enterprise

fit.variant: Polished buses and pads like the lit Exchange boards: flows of credit routed and priced, in bright violet on dark plum.

ideologies.why: A circuit of buses and pads carries the restless, transactional flow of the Exchange arcade, with the credit coin at its centre.

ideologies.name: Areanism

fit.variant: Heavy staggered tiles in close rust tones, like sintered regolith tile: raw, rooted, a whole planet's skin.
fit.emblem: The rust disc with the orbits of Phobos and Deimos.

ideologies.why: Bold, solid rust-red tiles of Mars' own soil suit a defiant native creed. The two-moon orbit is its own sign.

ideologies.name: Habitat Syndicalism

fit.variant: A hard, load-bearing triangular rib grid with filled pockets and bosses: collective strength, every rib carrying its share, in safety orange.
fit.emblem: The meshed gear of the union.

ideologies.why: A machined isogrid is practical, stubborn structure. Safety orange and the gear belong to the work crews.

ideologies.name: Margin Technocracy

fit.variant: Sparse, precise triangulated struts with lit hubs over faintly glazed panes, a calculated dome frame in cold margin green on near-black.

ideologies.why: Austere, exact geodesic struts read as engineered certainty. Margin green and the gauge dial are the Directorate's own.

factions.name: Arcadia Constabulary
factions.why: The blue shield of the Charter police and lock security.

factions.name: Habitat Systems Directorate
factions.why: The reserve gauge dial, with its green margin line.

factions.name: Landing Merchants' Exchange
factions.why: The Exchange's stacked-tower logo in gold piping.

factions.name: Colonial Assembly
factions.why: The open book at the centre of the Assembly's ring of stars.

factions.name: Regolith and Ice Workers' Union
factions.why: The RIWU's meshed gear on safety orange.

factions.name: Free Arcadia Movement
factions.why: The closed lock wheel of the Mars-born in rust red.

patrons.name: Mars Charter Authority
patrons.why: The Concord globe ringed by its orbit line.

patrons.name: Utopia Planitia Administration
patrons.why: The five-pointed gold star of the Utopia settlement.
